threads.body: This test only exercises a one-event stream (`_create_mock_impl` returns one `interaction_completed` event), so it can prove TTFC but never the `time_per_output_chunk` path that these new sync/async wrappers are meant to enable. Add a multi-event interaction stream and assert the per-output-chunk metric as well.
threads.hunk:

         self.assertEqual(span.attributes["gen_ai.usage.input_tokens"], 5)
         self.assertEqual(span.attributes["gen_ai.usage.output_tokens"], 8)
